name: Vertical Maintenance Shaft
description: A claustrophobic vertical tunnel with ladders stretching up and down into infinity. Pipes and cables line the walls like metal veins. Echo makes every sound haunting. Emergency lights cast red shadows. Graffiti from maintenance workers past reads: 'Abandon hope,' 'The cake is a lie,' and 'Bert was here 1987-2087.' Something drips from above. Something growls from below. This is why you should have taken that job at the nice, normal, non-dimensional hotel.
